subject: System Design
title: Service Discovery
description: Learn Service Discovery in one minute.

hook.text: Service A needs to call Service B. But Service B has 20 instances across 3 data centers. Which one?

buildup.text: Service discovery maintains a registry of available service instances and their locations.

discovery.text: Consul, etcd, and Kubernetes DNS register services automatically as they start and deregister when they stop.

twist.text: Stale registries route traffic to dead instances. Health checks must be fast and frequent to stay accurate.

climax.text: Service discovery is the address book of microservices — without it, services can't find each other.

punchline.text: Services register themselves; others look them up.

quiz.question: What does service discovery do?
options: Maintains a registry of available service instances and their locations
